newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real rises 0.14 pct on dollar inflows.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real rises 0.14 pct on dollar inflows.

text.p: Brazil's real rose 0.14 percent to close at 1.0733 per dollar on net dollar inflows in the commercial foreign exchange market, dealers said.
At 1640 local time/1940 GMT, preliminary figures for commercial and financial forex contracts showed a $375 million surplus.
Dealers said the large surplus was mostly due to two Eurobond issues by Sao Paulo state electrical firm Cesp totalling $360 million.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real dropped 0.08 percent to close at 1.0789 per dollar.
In the parallel market, the real fell 0.44 percent to end at 1.130 per dollar, traders said.
